dedupe_keys.name: stoat dynamic wastewater treatment works simulation model wrc freeware

description: STOAT is a PC-based tool from the UK consultancy WRc that dynamically simulates the performance of wastewater treatment works, distributed as freeware for Windows. It can model single treatment processes or a whole works including sludge processes, septic tank imports and recycle streams, using both biological and chemical oxygen demand models and WRc's activated sludge models built on ASM1, ASM2, ASM2d and ASM3, with biological nutrient removal and sequencing batch reactor options. Users can test how a works responds to changes in influent load, capacity or operating conditions, run batch simulations, and exchange data through a COM interface or the OpenMI water sector standard, and it can link with sewerage and river quality models. WRc also offers Plan-It STOAT, developed with CDM, for hydraulic and process capacity, cost and footprint design. Coverage: works-scale processes anywhere. Access: a free download from WRc, with the licence text not read on the page. Caveats: closed source, and the page names no validation data. It supports treatment works resilience, load shock and upgrade studies, and relates to the DHI WEST and SUMO wastewater simulators in the catalogue.
